roomNotes.Z02: Handloom references throughout: the Jamdani-inspired panel under a brass picture light, five 'warp and weft' hangings (khadi, indigo with kantha running stitch, undyed jute, madder, striped khadi), a kantha-stitched jute rug, stitched cushions, and fabric rolls with coconut-shell buttons on the visitor ledge. Design references only: makers and fibres are to be identified and credited; nothing here is claimed as artisan-made.
roomNotes.Z30: Illustrative knitwear on the four forms (cable, rib, moss and waffle stitches; not an actual collection) and a tactile materials library on the material table: yarn cones, stitch swatches, and coconut-shell buttons from shell to blank to finished button; fibre, origin and test data: pending supplier records. Water & Wellbeing refill point at the counter: the drinking water is client-stated to come from a deep tube well; no laboratory results are available yet, so none are shown. The client states the building runs on solar power; energy figures will appear only with real monitoring data.
roomNotes.Z08: Fabric review trays on the table for material discussions with buyers and visiting designers.
roomNotes.Z12: Current development samples and a swatch study on the credenza, beside the existing frame and books.
roomNotes.Z07: Monitors show generic placeholder screens, not real buyer data.
roomNotes.Z18: Daylight from the east windows; pin-up and review surfaces suit workshops with visiting designers. True north, sun angles and glare at the desks are still to be measured on site.
